context: Tracked in the todo-db tracker as update-item-not-before-clear (copied 2026-10-28).
description: The tracker says `not_before=""` clears a hold, and `take` tells callers to use it. Called through the MCP bridge in a coding-agent session on 2026-10-23, `update_item(id, not_before="")` returned `E_STATE operation produced no state change` (and with a context field alongside it changed only the context), so the hold stayed. `not_before=null` was also a no-op. The only way to release the hold was to set a near-future timestamp and wait. Reproduce, then fix in todo-db (argument handling drops empty strings, or the clear path is not wired), add a regression test, and make `take`'s hint accurate.
